summary: Contestants create a letter requesting a job shadow experience and participate in an interview about their career interests. The event includes both a written submission and a judged interview, and is open to middle level students. Contestants must submit their letter and compete in both parts to be ranked.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes for interview
submission_requirements: One (1) copy of the job shadow request letter formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual for each round of the event (preliminary and final)
Contestant ID is required for all submissions
Materials must follow the organization’s BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
presubmit_items: Job Shadow Request Letter - PDF Format
competencies: Apply technical writing skills to produce request letter for job shadow experience
Demonstrate quality grooming through proper dress

rubric.criterion: Contestant submitted the Request Letter with Personal Statement in paragraph 2 (100 words or less) as PDF file.
Letter is addressed correctly and formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual.

rubric.description: Clearly and thoughtfully identifies the job shadow position and career interest; includes relevant context or connection to future goals.
Personal statement is well within the limit; highly focused, impactful, and effectively communicates key points.
Effectively showcases strengths with specific examples or achievements that align with career goals.
Goals are well-articulated, thoughtfully connected to career interests, and demonstrate ambition and direction.
Conclusion is thoughtful and professional; reinforces the message and ends with a strong, respectful salutation.

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Strong introduction; made a very positive first impression.
Positive, courteous, sincere, confident; good posture and eye contact.
Proper grammar and pronunciation; pleasant voice and tone.
Demonstrated strong job skills, good work habits, and problem-solving abilities.
Appropriate and informed answers; good knowledge of the position and company; demonstrated initiative and enthusiasm

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level.
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC.
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this judged team event.
Contestants must be registered for the national competition before the submission deadline and compete in both parts of the event to be ranked.
Each state is allowed three (3) entries.
